name: ANYbotics ANYmal Research with Manipulation Payload
summary: The research edition of the ANYmal quadruped with a torque-controlled arm developed with the ETH Zurich spin-off Duatic, an onboard NVIDIA Jetson GPU and open low-level joint control, launched at ICRA 2025 for mobile-manipulation research.

germany.statusNote: Offered by ANYbotics (Zurich) to research labs on request: interested researchers are asked to reach out via the ANYbotics website. No price or German partner is published; anybotics.com refused our reader (403) on 18 Nov 2026.

sellers.name: ANYbotics AG
sellers.note: Contact page as used in the ANYmal D record; the launch article asks researchers to reach out via the ANYbotics website.

notes: A research package, not the industrial inspection ANYmal D / ANYmal X (separate records).
Arm figures are Duatic's DynaArm data; Duatic shows the DynaArm on ANYmal as "optimized for outdoor legged robots". The combined system figures were not readable.
The gripper or end effector supplied with the payload is not named in the sources read.
